title: 7 Best Tabnine Alternatives in 2026
summary: Tabnine sunset its free Basic tier and pivoted to enterprise. Here are 7 better alternatives — from GitHub Copilot's free tier to Codeium's unlimited completions.
body_markdown: If your goal is to build and deploy an application without managing servers, databases, and deployment pipelines, none of the code assistants on this list solve that problem — they help you write code, but you still own the stack.[Blink](https://blink.new/) is built for this: describe your app in plain language, and Blink generates the entire application including database, auth, backend, and hosting. Free to start.
